text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket weeps with bitter 
frustration after being defeated by Narita 
Taishin.

Winning Ticket responded to all-out effort 
with all-out effort. Though she didn't put 
it into words, Narita Taishin seemed to 
acknowledge her for it.

Determined not to lose to her rivals next 
time, the days of training toward the 
Satsuki Sho began.
